# Test fixtures

All fixtures are synthetic: made-up products in the formats of their sources.

- `off-*.json`: products as the Open Food Facts API returns them.
- `nevo-synthetic.csv`: five made-up foods (codes 9001–9005) in the column layout of a NEVO-online CSV export.
  **No real NEVO data**: NEVO is copyrighted by RIVM and may not be committed to this repository.
